purpose: General edition selection keyboard focus and reload stability
changes: Retain the same readonly edition list and live version buttons while previewing a different edition of the same candidate family; replace the list when the family or actual choice objects change.

After selection controls are rebuilt, defer focus recovery only from the Window or an unavailable control inside the active selection panel. Reuse the current overlay generation, loaded/visible, view-model and top-surface guards.
Preserve a valid action already focused by the user; reject a stale selection callback after settings becomes the current surface.

Expand the existing related-editions fixture with real loaded, native-hidden Window focus and reload assertions; retain existing candidate, preview, exact edition and one-command confirmation assertions. Remove repeated identical before-switch renders.
Document keyboard focus after edition preview and selection reload.

coverage: All six Zhao Yun editions are executed through their actual Button command/parameter; each keeps its original live version Button focused and preserves the candidate count, preview marker, match revision and expected edition HP.
Each edition performs MoveFocus Next then Previous: 12 real managed focus transitions stay inside selection and return to the same button while preserving CreateSnapshot(0).
Both Zhao Yun to Ling Tong and Ling Tong to Zhao Yun replace the family controls and naturally restore a visible, enabled selection action before the test manually focuses another control.
Pending-prompt reload creates fresh choice objects, binds every rendered version button to a current object and rejects the retired choice.
Reload while an edition button owns focus restores exact keyboard focus to the currently selected candidate button.
Focusing confirmation after DataBind but before deferred Input recovery retains exact confirmation focus.
Opening settings before deferred selection recovery focuses its real default sound toggle; after opening callbacks are pumped, user motion-toggle focus stays there.
Preview, focus navigation, save/load and modal navigation preserve the real pending selection, revision and viewer snapshot; exact final edition confirmation commits once.
